caption: The drawing shows a single woven textile swatch with a rectangular shape, depicted centrally on a plain, off-white background. The fabric is divided into a grid of nine sections, three rows by three columns, each segment displaying different combinations of colors and weaving patterns. The primary colors of the textile are shades of red, brown, and a natural off-white or beige. The edges of the swatch are frayed, with loose threads extending from the top and sides, especially at the upper edge where several strands curve outward. Each section of the grid exhibits a different density and distribution of the red and beige threads, creating a checkerboard effect with varying intensities. The central vertical and horizontal stripes are lighter in color, with a more pronounced beige tone, while the corner sections are composed of deeper, reddish-brown hues. The drawing is rendered with attention to the texture and weave of the fabric, capturing the detail of the fibers and the irregularity where the threads are loose or fraying.
title: Piece of Homespun Wool
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
